body: Four writer files join the record and one card delta (v5) proposes how the site shows them; nothing runs. (1) S04_PACKET_20261031.md: the first Verse 2 in the shot-direction structure with kitchen blocks, S04-1 to S04-7 take 1 beside the posted card, Addendum C applied (the bomber over the tee; the chest ship shown only by S04-4's neckline pull; the ivory coat fixed; the customer question closed). Two readings the card did not make are named in its header: S04-3 carries lyric lines 30 to 32 with S04-4 cut into it as an insert, and S04-6 cuts in on line 34's tail; the card's cut points stay the alternates. Holds sum to 31.5 s of design against the provider's 31.3 s claim; the S04 beat grid is asked of the alignment lane. (2) P-5_DIALOGUE_PAGE_20261031.md: the exchange's lines (nine lines, sixty-six words, a four-line alternate). (3) INFORMANT_ADAPTATION_BRIEF_20261031.md: her reference round for the swarm, prepared and not sent, nine categories, the mechanical forearm on the character-left arm. (4) IMPROVEMENT_ROUND_OPENING_v2_REVIEW_20261031.md: the notebook round ran today on Ziggy's go through the Nyquist lane; run B is the v2-only return of record; outcomes are recorded on all 70 claims of the review entry (attached after the update): Q1 no change agreed; Q2 two items forwarded for Ziggy's adoption (the wardrobe bounce sentence; light sources labelled on both sides, four wrong labels corrected); Q3 restates the source; Q4 two of three claimed errors refuted with the geometry written out and the third a wording fix for P-5. For the site: delta v5 adds the four links, the publication list and three review_requests (two adoption items and one information item) for Ziggy's pass; the queue is the place and the writer adopts nothing. The five opening take-2 blocks wait for that pass so one take 2 carries the answers, the adopted items and the dialogue page. The panel-view proposal of 12:48 still waits for your return. The sender id nyquist_claude (the Nyquist lane's session) is not in the mailbox registry; the registry's owner decides. DECISIONS section 17 and the START_HERE block are appended.
